authority: Direct user instruction in the resource-management conversation; supersedes blanket no-retry wording for a verified fault after its fix.
user_words: yeah but something went wrnog obviously and should be fixed then rerun then discuss with coordinator and run it yeah?
scope: The currently authorized five-frequency simulated-C comparison and remaining B1 work. Keep original inputs, settings, failures and completed results.
procedure: Inspect the actual failure and its logs. Distinguish an execution or implementation fault from a legitimate numerical limit or poor recovery.
Coordinate with the owning baseline or BEM coordinator before changing their code or restarting their case. Keep the single-owner solver lock.
For a verified bug, preserve the failed attempt, make the smallest correction, and run the minimum check that demonstrates the correction.
Rerun only the affected case or failed post-processing in a separate attempt, under the current resource limits. Do not repeat an unchanged failing command or duplicate a live fit.
Compare the new outcome, record the cause, fix and rerun, then commit and push the owned code and evidence. Continue the rest of the approved queue.

Poor recovery alone does not authorize changing data, frequencies, starts, numerical limits or published settings to improve a score. Diagnose it and let the owning coordinator decide within existing user authorization.
implementation_boundary: The detached resource monitor changes launch ceilings and writes status; it does not autonomously diagnose code, implement fixes or restart fits. Those actions require the owning coding coordinator/agent.
delivery: Recorded in the shared resource_policy.json read by both coordinators. No pane message sent; coordinator acknowledgement of this new recovery instruction is not yet confirmed.
